items.title: A second description of modules over a fibre product of rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a second description of the module theory over a fibre product of rings, and the proof is a 21-line argument that identifies the two candidate descriptions by explicit maps. It sets up the two module categories obtained by base change along the structure maps, exhibits a map in each direction between them, checks on elements that the two composites are the identity, and thereby obtains the equivalence; the verification of the two composites is where the content lies, since the rest is the standard construction of the functors. Both composites are checked on elements and displayed.
